reviews.title: Built my dream PC and gen5 ssd is the cherry on top
reviews.comment: Took the plunge and built a new gaming setup after years on an aging desktop. Boot times are laughably fast. Installing updates or big Steam files feels noticeably snappier. I know storage isn’t the flashiest upgrade, but this Gen5 drive lowkey made the whole PC feel next-gen. MSI's board made it easy to install and included a solid M.2 heatsink which keeps temps in check. The drive does run warm under heavy load, but nothing scary. Just make sure your case has decent airflow.
reviews.author: Sunnie
